title: Structure engineering button
description: A square-cornered 44px box with a 1px border: an uppercase mono label, then a separate square cell with a thin arrow. On hover the box inverts in 0.25s and the arrow shakes side to side twice. Outline (ink on paper), media (light over a dark photo), solid ink, and submit (ink with highlight text for the highlight band).
notes: put the class group/secard on a parent card link to shake the arrow from the card's hover
media is meant for dark photo backdrops; submit for the highlight-coloured band
